row.notes: myteam-g2: Callback for the ai_resource_gain_rate / player_resource_gain_rate stat listeners (KB). Iterates the changed-stat id set (rp+0x5c0), finds the member by id (+0x52/+0x50), reads its entry list and writes the new gain rate FUN_14122b200(rp, member_key) into each entry's field +0x28 (0x30-byte entries). Hook: change FUN_14122b200 or the +0x28 floats to change RP income rate.

verify.notes: V9014 Iterates the id set at rp+0x5c0, matches members by short +0x52 / byte +0x50, does two hash lookups and writes FUN_14122b200(rp, member key) into field +0x28 of each 0x30-stride entry. Registration site at 0x141227246 sits right beside the string player_resource_gain_rate.
